name: 98Token swap helper unprotected swapTokensForTokens()
summary: The 98 swap contract's public swapTokensForTokens(address[],uint256,uint256,address) spends the contract's own token balance and sends the proceeds to a caller-supplied recipient, so the attacker drained its entire 98 holding to itself.
